name: Asaka Soushi
source:
He is Shinichiro's older brother and a legal advisor to the detective agency.

He is cold, calculating, and manipulative, but his soft-spoken manner makes people around him unaware of it.

He loves to bully Shinichiro and seems to be in a secret dispute with Nanami.

[Translated from [url=http://amusecraft.com/platinumlabel/platinum_me/project/sukisyo3.html]official website[/url]]
